page.layout: One printed page. Top: woodcut ornament, then the dedication title block centred in several lines (larger roman and italic type). Below it, a block of text in two lines of signature-like address, then the body of text starting with a large woodcut initial D beside the first lines. Running text fills the page to the foot. Bottom centre: a small signature mark and a page number. No margin notes.
page.notes: The dedication title block is set in mixed roman and italic type with small capitals; the lines are transcribed as printed, with the long s written as s. The large initial D is joined to the word "OCTRINAM" as printed ("DOCTRINAM"). The word "Fuê-" ends a line and continues on the next page with a hyphen; the printed circumflex over the e is kept. The line "ISAACVS CASAVBONVS S." is a speaker/author line and is kept as a paragraph. The page number "2" is printed in the signature area at the foot and is also the gathering signature "ā 2"; the page number is given as "2".
